name: item-class-2026
summary: An item class the 2016 exe does not know (2026's class 39 keys / tickets) is treated as class 0 instead of asserting and returning garbage.
why: 2026 adds item class 39 (10 items: instance entry keys / tickets / event passes - SPT_Key 'The Key of Falsification',
EOL_Key, MOM_Key, SUS_Key, TEP_Key, 140IDTicket, BHKaren_Ticket, E_PumpkinPass, E_SnowmanPermit, E_Xmas2023_Key - all
MaxLot 1, no use skill). ItemAttributeClassContainer::operator[] knows ItemClassEnum 0..38 (cmp eax,0x27 / setl): on 39
it asserts 'Invalid item class[39]' and RETURNS THE CONTAINER ITSELF as the class attribute, so the caller fails.
Character.exe does this on every login with such an item and on the DB move of a swap that involves one - the 2026
client's inventory sort then shows 'Failed to move the item.' (zone so_NC_ITEMDB_fail -> 0x084F; operator 2026-10-07,
Annaaa: Protection (Tier 5) slot 124 <-> SPT_Key slot 51). An unknown class now takes class 0 (ITEMCLASS_BYTELOT, the
2016 class of plain single items - Engagement Ring, Iron Box), which is what these items are to a 2016 server.
Data stays 2026 (ItemInfo is checksummed with the 2026 client - both hold the same file).

edits.why: operator[] class >= 39: push eax / push msg (assert) -> xor eax,eax ; jmp +0x15 (the class-0 lookup)
